regulatoryNotice: Interest rates are governed by statutory regulations and Nidhi Rules, 2014. Deposits and loans are exclusively available to registered members.

fixedDeposit.title: Fixed Deposit Scheme
fixedDeposit.shortDescription: Lump-sum investment with quarterly compounding returns and flexible tenures.
highlights: High yield returns up to 12.00% per annum
Loan against FD facility available up to 90% of deposit value
Nomination facility available and recommended
Quarterly compounding ensures maximum maturity growth

recurringDeposit.title: Recurring Deposit Scheme
recurringDeposit.shortDescription: Systematic monthly disciplined savings plan that matures with high accumulated interest.
highlights: Cultivates systematic monthly savings discipline
Starting from as low as ₹500 per month
Loans available against active regular RD accounts
Guaranteed returns credited upon maturity

monthlyIncomeScheme.title: Monthly Income Scheme (MIS)
monthlyIncomeScheme.shortDescription: Ideal for retirees and passive income seekers looking for guaranteed monthly interest cash flow.
highlights: Predictable monthly earnings credited straight into your account
100% Principal amount returned securely at end of term
Great for senior citizens and household budget support
Loan against deposit facility accessible anytime

dailyDepositScheme.title: Daily Deposit Scheme (DDS / Pigmy)
dailyDepositScheme.shortDescription: Small daily doorstep savings collection designed specifically for shopkeepers, traders, and daily earners.
highlights: Authorized agent doorstep collection with physical/digital receipts
Save small amounts daily (starts at ₹50/day)
Senior citizens receive 0.50% extra interest on eligible tenures
Emergency loan availability after 6 months of regular deposits

savingsAccount.title: Savings Account
savingsAccount.shortDescription: Flexible deposit account with competitive annual interest and hassle-free liquidity.
highlights: Higher returns (5.00% to 5.50% p.a.) compared to regular commercial banks
Passbook facility and instant transaction alerts
Interest calculated on daily product balance and credited half-yearly
Zero hidden account maintenance charges

goldLoan.title: Loan Against Gold
goldLoan.shortDescription: Instant credit against gold ornaments with safe bank-grade vault custody and zero hidden penalties.
goldLoan.maxLtv: Up to 75% of market gold value
highlights: Immediate disbursal with minimal documentation
Ornaments insured and stored in bank-grade safe custody
Flexible repayment options (monthly interest or bullet repayment)
Zero prepayment or pre-closure penalty

loanAgainstDeposit.title: Loan Against Deposit
loanAgainstDeposit.shortDescription: Immediate liquidity against your FD or RD without breaking your investment or losing interest.
highlights: Avail up to 90% of your Fixed or Recurring Deposit value
Your original deposit keeps accumulating interest normally
Zero CIBIL requirement; secured by your own deposit
Simple, single-page application procedure

loanAgainstProperty.title: Loan Against Property
loanAgainstProperty.shortDescription: Leverage residential or commercial real estate equity for business expansion or personal goals.
highlights: Substantial loan quantum for business growth or personal needs
Transparent valuation and prompt legal verification
Competitive reducing balance interest rates
Structured EMI plans to fit your monthly cash flow

otherLoans.title: Other Loan Schemes
otherLoans.shortDescription: Credit facilities against Government Securities, National Savings Certificates (NSC), and Kisan Vikas Patra (KVP).
highlights: Pledge NSC, KVP, or approved postal securities
Retain underlying maturity gains of the securities
Convenient repayment schedules tailored to members
